## How to use this book

- Begin with Chapter 1 if the reader is new to computers, memory, Rust, or reverse engineering.
- Explain unfamiliar terms in plain English before using them.
- Treat code as Windows-focused Rust unless a page says otherwise.
- Keep the educational safety boundary: use open-source games, owned software, and isolated local labs. Do not apply the material to systems or players without permission.
- Prefer the canonical chapter URLs below rather than guessing paths.
